[View the ADEQ Hourly Forecast for Yuma]
Daily ozone levels will remain in the Good AQI category for the next several days. Breezy conditions are possible Friday, and this is forecasted to limit ozone concentrations. Otherwise

areas.ag: Imperial County Air Pollution Control District
areas.t: Today, as a cold front departs southeastern California, westerly winds will gradually weaken, reducing the potential for blowing dust. However, lingering dust from the overnight and early morning hours will lead to high-Moderate AQI levels for PM10.  Tomorrow, upper-level high pressure passing north
